purpose: Public FiveM server recipes published by their maintainers. Listings link to the recipe pages and carry no hosted files.

items.name: FiveM Basic Server (Legacy)
items.author: Cfx.re / txAdmin
items.description: Start a clean Legacy server with the default resources and configuration. A good starting point for testing individual resources.
requirements: Use the recommended FiveM Legacy server build and a Cfx.re server key.
Choose FiveM Basic Server (Legacy) in Popular Recipes.

items.name: FiveM Basic Server (Enhanced)
items.author: Cfx.re / txAdmin
items.description: Set up a minimal server for GTA V Enhanced, with a basic game mode, spawn handling and sample maps.
requirements: Use the Enhanced server build and a Cfx.re server key. On Windows, install the Microsoft Visual C++ redistributable linked by Cfx.re.
Choose FiveM Basic Server (Enhanced) in Popular Recipes.

items.name: Qbox Framework
items.author: Qbox Project contributors
items.description: Qbox’s full roleplay starter. It includes jobs, vehicles and inventory along with the framework’s other active resources.
requirements: Install a current FXServer build and MariaDB 10.9 or newer. Qbox does not support MySQL or XAMPP.
Choose Qbox Framework in Popular Recipes and provide your database connection and Cfx.re server key.

items.name: Qbox Lean
items.author: Qbox Project contributors
items.description: A smaller Qbox base for building your own server. The recipe leaves out the bundled civilian and criminal activities.
requirements: Use the same FXServer and MariaDB requirements as Qbox Framework.
Open the recipe page, copy the Raw URL and paste it into txAdmin’s Remote URL Template.

items.name: ESX Legacy
items.author: ESX Framework
items.description: The official ESX roleplay starter, with character registration, jobs, society accounts and vehicle shops.
requirements: Have a current FXServer build, a Cfx.re server key and a running MariaDB instance before you deploy.
Choose ESX Legacy in Popular Recipes. The recipe installs oxmysql and loads the initial SQL.

items.name: QBCore Framework (legacy listing)
items.author: JericoFx, Kakarot and Hamy
items.description: The original QBCore roleplay recipe includes jobs, gangs, housing and vehicles. txAdmin no longer recommends it in Popular Recipes.
requirements: Set up FXServer, a Cfx.re server key and MariaDB as described in the QBCore guide.
The QBCore guide still shows an older Popular Recipes menu. Copy the Raw URL from the recipe page and use Remote URL Template instead.
